Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Question raised at the 2007 EC:
> When a minion burns an incapacitated Imbued, how many conviction can a
> given ready imbued burn for damage in retaliation?

Just one. Each imbued can burn 1 conviction to inflict 1 damage. Not X
conviction to inflict X damage.
